# docker_container_file (Data Source)

Reads a path inside a container: its stat (name, size, mode, mtime, link target) and, for a regular file, its content as base64. It uses the Engine archive API (`HEAD` and `GET /containers/{id}/archive`), like `docker container cp CONTAINER:PATH -`, and works on stopped containers too. For a directory or symlink only `stat` is filled and `content_base64` is null. Files larger than 32 MiB are an error. Decode the content with `base64decode()` (UTF-8 text) or pass it on as is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a configuration file a container generated on first start.
data "docker_container_file" "generated" {
  container = "app"
  path      = "/var/lib/app/generated.conf"
}

output "generated_conf" {
  value     = base64decode(data.docker_container_file.generated.content_base64)
  sensitive = true
}

output "generated_conf_size" {
  value = data.docker_container_file.generated.stat.size
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container` (String) The container to read, by ID or name.
- `path` (String) Absolute path inside the container, e.g. `/etc/nginx/nginx.conf`.

### Read-Only

- `container_id` (String) ID of the container the file was read from.
- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive) The file content (single regular file extracted from the GET /containers/{id}/archive tar), base64-encoded.
- `content_base64_sha256` (String) sha256 of content_base64.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `stat` (Attributes) The path stat as a nested object. Keys come from the base64 JSON in the header (moby container.PathStat); swagger documents the header but not its keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stat))
- `stat_json` (String) The decoded X-Docker-Container-Path-Stat header (HEAD /containers/{id}/archive) as JSON.
- `stat_json_sha256` (String) sha256 of stat_json.

<a id="nestedatt--stat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stat`

Read-Only:

- `link_target` (String) Upstream `linkTarget`.
- `mode` (Number) Upstream `mode`.
- `mtime` (String) Upstream `mtime`.
- `name` (String) Upstream `name`.
- `size` (Number) Upstream `size`.
